product_category.value: Immersive VR simulation platform dedicated to nursing education

evidence.quote: UbiSim is dedicated exclusively to nursing education simulation and Virtual Reality.
The UbiSim immersive virtual reality simulation platform is built by nurses, for nurses
UbiSim works on the entire wireless Quest family of headsets, including Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest Pro.
A laptop or desktop computer with Windows/Mac operating system and Chrome browser. No software installation required.

platforms.note: Learners use Meta Quest headsets. The second quote describes the facilitator's computer, which runs in a Chrome browser; the pages do not describe a web or desktop mode for learners, so Web is not listed as a learner platform. Pricing page also mentions 'web replay' for debriefing.

value: Peer-reviewed scenario catalog (Med-Surg, Peds, OB, Mental Health)
Multiplayer: up to 3 learners in one simulation
Observation mode, on computer or as a 'ghost' in VR
Pre-brief, simulation and debrief with web replay

evidence.quote: No-code, intuitive scenario editor
Peer-reviewed and standards-aligned sims across Med-Surg, Peds, OB, and Mental Health
Community-built scenarios from other programs
Up to 3 active learners can collaborate together in the same simulation
Peers can learn by actively observing the simulation on their computers or joining the simulation as a “ghost” in virtual reality.
Facilitator-led & independent, with AI-assisted options
AI-powered patient dialogue
Instant, AI-enhanced performance reports
Multi-tiered debriefing with self-guided reflection, quizzes, and web replay
Enterprise security, SSO, and data privacy compliance

key_capabilities.note: CONFLICT on AI dialogue: the pricing page lists 'AI-powered patient dialogue' as included, but the AI capabilities page says 'Coming soon: AI-Supported Dialogue' and its meta description says 'Coming November 2025'. The AI page may be out of date. Treat the AI items as unconfirmed until checked.

target_customer.value: Nursing programs in higher education, and hospitals/health systems training new-graduate nurses (transition to practice). Licensed per institution; learners do not pay.

evidence.quote: meet the evolving needs of nurse learners in higher education and healthcare institutions.
UbiSim enables hospitals and healthcare systems to prepare new graduate nurses for the Transition to Practice
UbiSim is licensed at the institution or program level, so your institution covers access and learners don't pay out of pocket.

target_customer.note: Menus also list 'Workforce Development' as a third segment.

value_proposition.value: Nurse-designed, immersive VR that builds clinical judgment, confidence and communication skills, and lets programs scale clinical education at lower cost and workload.

evidence.quote: The UbiSim immersive VR simulation platform — designed by nurses, for nurses — builds clinical judgment, confidence, and communication skills in a safe and realistic environment.
UbiSim makes quality clinical education more scalable with training that costs less and reduces workload.
Where Nursing Practice Gets Real™.

tagline.note: Trademarked and repeated in the footer of every page read. Homepage's first headline is 'Today’s Nurses Train in UbiSim VR Simulation'.

pricing.value: Custom quote. Annual engagements typically start at $5,000 USD. Implementation is a separate one-time package (Basic, Essentials, Custom). Headsets not included. Free trials for qualified buyers.

evidence.quote: Annual engagements typically begin at $5,000 USD, depending on the solution and implementation requirements.
Implementation is a separate one-time package.
Headsets are not included with a UbiSim purchase.
UbiSim offers free trials for qualified buyers.
